activity.notes: Koimala (also represented in later Maldivian royal tradition as Mahaabarana Adeettiya / Maanaabarana) is a traditional or legendary early ruler credited with extending kingship over the whole Maldives before the Islamic conversion. Later Maldivian royal lists and modern historical retellings commonly assign a reign of 1117-1141, but the foundational narrative is retrospective and variant chronologies exist. This record therefore preserves the traditional sovereign-reign interval without treating either year as independently exact.

sources.title: Maldive Sovereigns from AD 1141 — Maldives Royal Family
sources.citation_text: The Maldivian royal list identifies Koimala, regnal name Maanaabarana, as a legendary ruler and gives accession in 1117 and death or abdication in 1141.

sources.title: Maldives history: From Sri Lankan Prince to first King — Daily FT
sources.citation_text: The 2025 historical feature states that King Mahaabarana Adeettiya (Koimala) governed the entire Maldives from 1117 to 1141 while explicitly presenting his Sri Lankan-prince origin as legend.
